explication: ShardingSphere is a database enhancement layer for connecting applications to heterogeneous databases. Its principal workflow has two entry modes—JDBC and Proxy—then SQL parsing, routing/rewrite, execution, and result merging. Other major branches include governance and metadata persistence, DistSQL, data migration, MCP-based workflows, and pluggable security and observability features. The README describes these capabilities at product level; sampled sources are selective, so links without direct evidence are omitted or marked unverified.
